prompts.title: Travel comparison dashboard
prompts.text: Create a responsive travel comparison dashboard with a date picker, metric cards summarizing price and duration, and a filterable data table of flight options. Use only IBM Carbon components and design tokens. Support desktop and mobile breakpoints.

prompts.title: Enterprise inventory table
prompts.text: Generate a data-dense inventory table with pagination, batch actions, and status tag badges for stock state. Use only IBM Carbon DataTable patterns and tokens. Keep the layout usable at 1440px and 375px.

prompts.title: Multi-step registration form
prompts.text: Build a multi-step user registration form with validation feedback, inline tooltips, and primary/secondary button controls. Use IBM Carbon Form, ProgressIndicator, TextInput, and Button. No custom CSS colors or pixel spacing.

prompts.title: Executive KPI card grid
prompts.text: Design an executive KPI card grid with trend indicators, dropdown filters, and accessible icon labels. Use Carbon Tile, Tag, Dropdown, and Grid/Column responsive props only.

prompts.title: Destructive confirmation modal
prompts.text: Synthesize a destructive action confirmation modal with clear messaging, a warning callout/notification, and focus-trapped primary danger and secondary cancel actions. Use IBM Carbon Modal and InlineNotification only—no hallucinated styles.
